Two real fake-printer WebSocket clients kept 'TEST KTP iter111 A' and 'TEST KTP iter111 B' online. (1) Android phone: ReactNativeWebView bridge + __SURIRENT_KTP__=true + ktp_device_token 'x' / ktp_device_name 'KT-V520 #9', default Chrome UA. On load both keys were removed from localStorage and nothing re-registered. No kiosk-ktp-pair-btn or kiosk-sheet-ktp-pair. No PRINT_RECEIPT bridge message (0 messages), no receipt-manual-print. With no printers online there are no history-print buttons and 0 bridge messages. (2) Real KT-V520: UA 'Android 11; V520' set via CDP plus navigator override, bridge present, ktp_device_token/name = printer B (the one that sorts first in /kiosk/printers/online, so a broken exclusion would be visible). The fake B log shows no REMOTE_PRINT for that payment and there were no remote:true bridge messages, so it never sent to itself. receipt-manual-print 'Ingebouwde printer' is visible. The KtpPrintButton has no chevron (single printer, self excluded). The history menu shows only history-print-ktp (hint 'TEST KTP iter111 A') plus history-print-local 'Ingebouwde printer'. Bonnen van vandaag rows show 'Print via KT-V520' (no chevron) plus 'Opnieuw'/'Ingebouwde printer'. (3) Regression, normal browser with no bridge: no pair button. The history menu shows only KTP (B). The success page (KW2026-00638) auto-sent 'Geprint op TEST KTP iter111 B' and has a chevron (2 printers). No receipt-manual-print; window.print was called 0 times.

issues: Rows that are not yet printed wrap 'Print via KT-V520' and 'Ingebouwde printer' onto 2 stacked lines, while printed rows ('Opnieuw') sit side by side. The list looks inconsistent; consider a shorter label (e.g. 'Ingebouwd') or a fixed 2-column grid.
3 identical 'Anita Sewdas' cards. Demo resets create new employee ids and print logs are keyed by employee_id; consider grouping by name or hiding employees with 0 logs.

action_items: Recommended hardening: exclude self by printer id, not by name. otherPrinters() compares p.name with localStorage ktp_device_name. If an admin renames the printer, the stored name goes stale, the KT-V520 no longer excludes itself, and it would auto-send REMOTE_PRINT to itself (double print). Store data.printer_id from /kiosk/printers/register and filter on id, or have the backend reject remote-print targeting the caller's own device.

Optional: detection depends only on the UA containing V520/KingTop. If a future APK build sets a custom WebView userAgent without Build.MODEL, a real KT-V520 would silently lose built-in printing and drop its pairing (the token is wiped on load). Consider having the APK inject the model explicitly (e.g. window.__SURIRENT_MODEL__) as a second, reliable signal.
critical_code_review_comments: isKtpDevice now requires bridge && UA regex. The flag and token no longer count, and the module-level cleanup removes a stale token/name for non-KTP devices. Verified working.
Every consumer (KtpPrintButton, usePrintOptions/PrintChoiceMenu) goes through otherPrinters(). Self-exclusion is centralised and correct, apart from the name-vs-id fragility above.
The module-level localStorage cleanup also runs on admin desktop browsers. That is harmless, but it is a side effect on import; it could move into startKioskLive/ensurePrinterRegistered.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use page.goto(url, wait_until='commit') and then wait for keypad-4; plain navigation often times out. When seeding localStorage via an init script, gate it with window.top===window && sessionStorage flag. Otherwise the receipt-preview iframe (same origin) re-runs the init script and re-seeds the keys, which is a false failure.
